intro: Our Grande dining table makes room for real connection. With a sturdy build and curved edges, it turns small dining rooms into relaxed gathering spaces.

features.title: Sized for real connection
features.text: The rectangular layout comfortably seats four—ideal for family dinners or relaxed meals with friends.

features.title: A top that feels refined
features.text: We've designed this dining set using smooth MDF tabletop, which adds durability while keeping things looking clean and minimal.

features.title: Legs that don’t wobble
features.text: Our solid sheesham wood frame offers lasting stability with a touch of natural texture for everryday use.

features.title: Toned to suit your space
features.text: Our cappuccino wood finish pairs beautifully with neutral or warm-toned interiors.

features.title: Built strong with real wood
features.text: With a solid rubberwood frame, our table stays firm and stable through years of use, no matter how lively the gathering.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
